'''Blaes of Matuchin''' is a character in the ballad, ''The Bargain of Rogosh Eagle-eye'', performed by [[Thom Merrilin]] in the common room of [[The Stag and Lion]] in [[Baerlon]] to honor past [[Horn of Valere|Heroes of the Horn]].{{ref/book|1|17}} She also existed in reality, though we do not know her real historical actions, as she was bound to the Horn.

==Appearance==
The prose of the ballad portrays her thusly: "strong as the ash she stands, as lithe as the willow's branch, and as beautiful as a rose.  Golden-haired Blaes."{{ref/book|1|17}} 

==History==
The ballad makes it clear that she is either royalty or high nobility as she has heralds and a court, the context infers something similar to a royal court.

It is mentioned in that ballad that the [[Dark One]] marked Blaes as his own, but she never turned to [[the Shadow]] and become a [[Darkfriend]], and would die before she ever yielded.{{ref/book|1|17}} 

==Activities==
When [[Matrim Cauthon]] first sounded the Horn at [[Falme]], Blaes was among the summoned Heroes. {{ref/book|2|47}}

During the [[Last Battle]], the Horn was sounded again, this time by [[Olver]], a feat possible due to Mat's "death" at the hands of [[Rahvin]] during [[The Fires of Heaven]] (which was reverted due to [[Rand al'Thor]] killing Rahvin with [[balefire]]). Blaes was summoned once again, and among other things, informed Mat of the powerful yet vulnerable nature of the Heroes.{{ref/book|14|39}}

{{quote|If we are wounded in dire ways, we will have to withdraw and recover in the [[World of Dreams]].|Blaes of Matuchin}}

===Trivia===
Mat considers her very pretty.{{ref/book|14|39}}
